from REGS or RHGS or (iii) generation based on hydro power sources, subject

1. (a) REGS or RHGS based on wind or solar sources or Hydro PSP ESS which
2. have declared commercial operation upto 30.6.2025 shall be considered for
3. waiver of transmission charges. for a period of 25 years from date of COD.
5. (b) Battery ESS charged with REGS or RHGS based on wind or solar sources
6. who have declared commercial operation upto 30.6.2025 shall be considered
7. for waiver of transmission charges for a period of 12 years from date of COD:
9. (c) ESS shall be considered for waiver of transmission charges, when such ESS
10. is meeting atleast 51% of its annual electricity requirement for pumping of
11. water or charging of battery with electricity generated from REGS or RHGS
12. based on wind or solar sources.
14. (d) Generation from Solar PV generating station under SECI manufacturing
15. linked capacity scheme (RFS No. SECI/C&P/RfS/2GW Manufacturing/P-
16. 3/R1/062019 dated 25.06.2019) for sale to entities having RPO irrespective
17. of date of COD of such generating station shall be considered for waiver of
18. transmission charges for a period of 25 years from date of COD.
20. (e) Hydro generating station where (a) PPAs are signed on or after 1.12.2022 but
21. on or before 30.06.2025 and (b) construction work is awarded on or before
22. 06.2025 shall be considered for waiver of transmission charges under this
23. Regulation, for a period of 18 years from the date of COD of the hydro
24. generating station
26. (f) REGS or RHGS based on wind or solar sources or Hydro PSP ESS or Battery
27. ESS which are declared under commercial operation after 30.6.2025 and upto
28. 6.2028 or new hydro projects where construction work is awarded and PPA
29. is signed after 30.06.2025 shall be considered as follows:
31. I. REGS or RHGS based on wind or solar sources or Hydro PSP ESS
